value.rationale: A canonical highly symmetric 20-vertex graph has adjacent-degree homology, and the full S5×C2 characters determine which classes survive label and complement quotients; both degrees are complement-odd, a non-obvious fact not predicted by Betti ranks. This is a natural complete equivariant classification, not a rank-only recomputation or arbitrary slice.
